title: Cash Pickup Cancellation, Fee Refund and Refund Timing Schedule
content:
**Schedule to the Cash Pickup service terms: cancellations and refunds.**

| Cash Pickup tier | Full-refund window after booking (hours) | Share of each fee refunded on a cancellation after that window (percent) | Cancellation allowed while ready for pickup | Refund issued within (Paloma business days) | Share of each fee refunded when Paloma cancels a held transfer (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 0.50 (30 minutes) | 100 | yes | 3 | 100 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 0.50 (30 minutes) | 0 | yes | 1 | 100 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 0.50 (30 minutes) | 50 | yes | 1 | 100 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 0.50 (30 minutes) | 100 | yes | 2 | 100 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 0.50 (30 minutes) | 0 | yes | 1 | 100 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 0.50 (30 minutes) | 100 | yes | 2 | 100 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The full-refund window is the Regulation E 30-minute cancellation right, expressed in elapsed hours. Inside it, a cancellation refunds the principal and every fee in full. The figure is the same on every tier.
- After the window, the post-window share column applies to each fee. Cash Pickup Express and Cash Pickup Cardless ATM refund 0 percent, Cash Pickup Express Plus refunds 50 percent, and the other three tiers refund 100 percent.
- On every tier a transfer may be cancelled while it is ready for pickup and not yet collected.
- The refund-timing column counts Paloma business days from the day the refund becomes owed.
